problem_statement: When a multicast DNS host or service name conflicts with another device on the network (the registration reports a duplicate-name error), and the same name is re-registered while still in the conflict state, no probe messages are sent. The entry should re-enter the probing phase and emit probe queries for the name upon an explicit re-registration request, just as it would when re-registered after being removed; instead it stays stuck in the conflict state and re-registration silently succeeds without ever probing.
oracle_note: observed by validate_instance.py (fail before, pass after the fix); the unit oracle is per executable, so check attribution of the cases to the PR's change
